steps.en: Read the offline-WeChat notice and choose the Kimi K2.5 entry
steps.zh: 读微信下线提示，选择 Kimi K2.5 入口

steps.en: Maps the chosen model heading to an executable and a separate instructions URL
steps.zh: 将所选模型标题映射到 EXE 与独立说明 URL

steps.en: Follow its file link to the download entry and retain the matching instructions URL
steps.zh: 沿文件链接找到下载入口，保留匹配说明 URL

value.en: The selected artifact and its instructions entry are located, not verified or executed
value.zh: 找到所选产物与说明入口，不表示已验证或执行
